identity_rules.ret-copy-chain: call <alloc>; mov r,eax (callee-saved r); mov eax,r; ret
identity_rules.ret-slot-forward: call <alloc>; mov [var_N],eax; mov eax,[var_N]; ret; slot not address-taken in the function
identity_rules.transformed: any add/sub/inc/dec/and/or/xor/shift/neg/not/imul/... on the allocation value breaks identity -> candidate only

meta.soundness_gate: RET evidence requires: >=1 ret site whose eax is exactly an allocator call result (NEW) and every other ret site is NEW or NULL (xor eax,eax / mov eax,0); size must be proven by A_push_imm / B_mov_imm / C_imul / D_lea_scale / E_shl; Hex-Rays/IDA annotations are never used as evidence.
meta.semantics: sizes/sems carry AV-family semantics: sem=total -> pointee sizeof equals size or divides it; sem=elem -> sizeof equals size. Wiring side computes class candidates from tools/class_layouts.json exactly like the AV family (per-ent OR over observed (size,sem)).
meta.wiring_note: future family (e.g. RN): identical size->mask computation as the AV family (sem=total: sizeof==size or sizeof|size; sem=elem: sizeof==size; per-ent OR over (size,sem) pairs). CRITICAL: entities are pointer VALUES (RET:/EAX:). Under the current axis policy AV sits in _POINTEE_FAMS and all 807 AV masks are axis-dropped on P/M/G/S value entities (see solver log), so copying AV's family placement would make RN inert. Wire RN as a value-axis family (like EP/C10, whose class atoms mean 'pointer to class') or explicitly exempt it.
meta.candidate_note: candidates are NOT evidence: identity partially proven, transformed, mixed return sites, or size unresolved.
